name: Sakura Toumi
source:
A girl with the nickname "Witch of the Computer Room" due to her taciturn and mysterious impression. 

Often thought to be reticent, but in reality, she wants to talk a lot. 
Her curiosity often overrides her sense of common sense and ethics, which has led her to develop an interest in things like moe and erotic topics. 
She also has a bit of a naive personality.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1167060&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
